This blade is highly valued thanks to its ease of use and high attack power.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 26 |durability = 27 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Knight's Broadsword}} Knight's Broadswords are [[Weapon]]s that [[Link]] can use to defeat [[Enemy|Enemies]], destroy [[Barrel]]s and [[Jar]]s, and cut down [[Tree]]s. Knight's Broadswords will deal 26 damage to Enemies, and 52 damage when thrown and broken on an Enemy. They were once used by the [[Knight of Hyrule|Hylian Knights]] before the second [[Great Calamity]]. In the present, they are commonly used by adventurers due to their ease of use and high attack power. Scanning the following [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Knight's Broadsword: * {{SSB}} Series [[Link]] amiibo * {{SSB|-}} Series [[Young Link]] amiibo * {{SSB|-}} Series [[Toon Link]] amiibo * {{TLoZ}} Series [[Link]] ({{TLoZ}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series Young Link ({{MM}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series Toon Link ({{TWW}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{TP}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{SS}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series Link (Rider) amiibo Knight's Broadswords will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Being magnetic, however, Link can use his [[Magnesis]] Rune on them. However, this also means that they will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]], and they will conduct [[Electricity]]. They will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Knight's Broadswords belong to the equipment archetype known as the [[Knight's Gear]], which was primarily used by the Hylian Knights.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_003" |Life = 27 |Power = 26 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 45 |BuyingPrice = 180 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = One-Handed Weapon |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Knight's Broadsword}} {{Stub|TotK}} Like the other Knight's Gear melee weapons, the Knight's Broadsword does bonus damage when Link has one Heart or less remaining. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:AoC Knight's Broadsword Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of the Knight's Broadsword ==See Also== {{See Also| * Decayed Weapon * Knight's Broadsword✨ * Knight's Gear * One-Handed Weapon * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Broadswords, Knight's Gear, Swords, Weapons, One-Handed Weapons |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
